team_rules: Team rule (Priya, SRE lead): roll back the most recent deploy first, debug forward second. Never restart a database primary without DBA approval.
Team rule: any config change to production payments services requires a second engineer to approve in #oncall-approvals before it is applied.
Team preference: incident summaries must lead with customer impact and end with a single recommended next action.

incidents.title: Checkout 5xx spike 12 minutes after deploy 2024.11.3
incidents.symptoms: 5xx rate jumped from 0.2% to 18%. Requests time out after 30s. Deploy of checkout-api v2024.11.3 finished 12 minutes earlier. DB connections timing out, pool saturation on app pods.
incidents.logs: HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms. Active=20 Idle=0 Waiting=143
incidents.root_cause: New release added a per-request DB call inside a loop and the Hikari connection pool (max 20) was exhausted.
incidents.resolution: Rolled back to v2024.11.2, then raised the connection pool size to 40 and fixed the N+1 query.
incidents.note: Rollback restored service in 6 minutes; the pool size increase was the durable fix.

incidents.title: Order events consumer lag climbing past 2M messages
incidents.symptoms: Kafka consumer lag on order-events grows steadily. Consumers keep leaving and rejoining the group. Throughput drops to near zero for minutes at a time.
incidents.logs: Attempt to heartbeat failed since group is rebalancing. Revoking previously assigned partitions. member=order-consumer-7 rebalance count=41/hour
incidents.root_cause: max.poll.interval.ms was lower than batch processing time after a slow downstream call, causing a rebalance storm.
incidents.resolution: Raised max.poll.interval.ms to 600000 and reduced max.poll.records from 500 to 100; lag drained in 25 minutes.
incidents.note: Adding pods made it worse because every join triggered another rebalance.

incidents.title: Internal services rejecting calls from auth-gateway, TLS handshake errors
incidents.symptoms: Sudden wave of 503s across internal services. All calls through the mesh from auth-gateway fail. Nothing was deployed in the last 24 hours.
incidents.logs: x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid: current time 2024-11-14T02:00:04Z is after 2024-11-14T01:59:59Z. remote error: tls: bad certificate
incidents.root_cause: The internal mTLS intermediate certificate expired; the cert-manager renewal job had been failing silently for 30 days.
incidents.resolution: Manually reissued the intermediate certificate, restarted the mesh sidecars, and added an expiry alert at 14 days.
incidents.note: Rolling back deploys is useless here because no deploy caused it. Check cert expiry first for handshake errors.

incidents.title: Payments API timeouts and 5xx after Thursday release
incidents.symptoms: 5xx spike on payments-api shortly after the release. Requests timing out at 30s. Database connection pool saturation on the app pods, waiting requests piling up.
incidents.logs: QueuePool limit of size 10 overflow 5 reached, connection timed out, timeout 30.00. pool exhausted, waiting=88
incidents.root_cause: A new endpoint held DB connections open during an external fraud-check call, exhausting the connection pool.
incidents.resolution: Rolled back the release, moved the fraud-check call outside the DB transaction, and raised the pool size from 10 to 25.
incidents.note: Same signature as INC-101; recognising it early saved most of the time.

incidents.title: Users randomly logged out, Redis evictions rising
incidents.symptoms: Users report being logged out at random. Redis hit rate dropped from 97% to 61%. Memory usage pinned at maxmemory.
incidents.root_cause: A new feature stored 40KB profile blobs in session keys, and allkeys-lru began evicting live sessions.
incidents.resolution: Moved profile blobs to a separate Redis, set session keys to volatile-lru, and scaled memory to 24G.
incidents.note: Look at key size distribution first next time.

incidents.title: Invoice events consumer stuck, lag growing, members flapping
incidents.symptoms: Kafka consumer lag on invoice-events keeps growing. Consumer group rebalances repeatedly and members keep leaving and rejoining. Throughput drops to near zero.
incidents.logs: Attempt to heartbeat failed since group is rebalancing. Member invoice-consumer-3 sending LeaveGroup request. rebalance count=37/hour
incidents.root_cause: max.poll.interval.ms too low for batch processing time again, same rebalance storm as order-events.
incidents.resolution: Raised max.poll.interval.ms to 600000 and reduced max.poll.records to 100. Did not add pods.
incidents.note: Went straight to the poll interval fix.

incidents.title: Billing worker cannot reach ledger service, TLS bad certificate
incidents.symptoms: All calls from billing-worker to ledger-service fail with handshake errors. No deploys in the last day. Errors began exactly at midnight UTC.
incidents.logs: tls: failed to verify certificate: x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid. remote error: tls: bad certificate
incidents.root_cause: The ledger-service leaf certificate expired because the renewal job was failing silently, same failure mode as auth-gateway.
incidents.resolution: Reissued the leaf certificate, restarted sidecars, and verified cert-manager renewal alerts cover ledger-service.
incidents.note: Skipped the rollback and checked cert expiry immediately.

incidents.title: Search API latency and 5xx after canary promotion
incidents.symptoms: 5xx spike and 30s request timeouts on search-api after promoting the canary. Database connections timing out, pods report connection pool saturation with many waiting requests.
incidents.logs: Timeout acquiring connection from pool: pool exhausted, active=30 idle=0 waiting=210
incidents.root_cause: A cache miss path fell back to per-item DB lookups, exhausting the connection pool.
incidents.resolution: Rolled back the canary, batched the lookups, and raised the pool size to 45.
incidents.note: Third connection-pool incident this quarter; recall led straight to the pool.
